integrity.proof_basis: Symbolic derivation from the error recurrence and constant-term lower bound.

scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the exact order-n models z^n-1 and z^n+1 with n>=4.
The controller class is scalar LTI with numerator degree less than n and a shared filter on all eigendirections.
No claim is made for arbitrary unit-circle pole configurations, matrix-valued or non-LTI filters, noise, constraints, or time-varying Hessians.
title: Exact optimal rate for periodic and antiperiodic quadratic tracking
